claims: Divine Mercy Sunday in 2026 is celebrated on April 12, 2026.
April 12, 2026 is the Second Sunday of Easter.
The Second Sunday of Easter is the Octave of Easter.
A nine-day novena begins on Good Friday, April 3, 2026.
Divine Mercy Sunday is a feast day in the Catholic Church.
A plenary indulgence can be obtained on Divine Mercy Sunday under the usual conditions.
The usual conditions include sacramental confession.
The usual conditions include Eucharistic Communion.
The usual conditions include prayer for the Pope's intentions.
The National Shrine of the Divine Mercy holds special services.
